query:
SELECT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM model_tariffs mt
            JOIN deployed_models dm ON dm.id = mt.deployed_model_id
            WHERE dm.alias = $1
              AND dm.deleted = false
              AND mt.valid_until IS NULL
              AND (mt.input_price_per_token > 0 OR mt.output_price_per_token > 0)
        ) as "has_paid_tariff!"
